key.name: labels
key.description: Maps an IANA timezone id to a user-chosen display label (e.g. "Home") shown instead of the city name in the panel and menu.

key.name: separator
key.description: The string inserted between timezone entries in the panel and menu. An empty string means "use legacy behavior": the existing boolean "showSeparator" key in "config" decides between a " | " separator and four spaces. Set to a non-empty value (typically one of the "value" strings from separators.js) to override that legacy behavior explicitly.

key.name: formatting
key.description: Maps an IANA timezone id to a JSON-encoded per-entry formatting object of the shape {"size": <int pt or 0=inherit>, "color": "#rrggbb" or "", "boldCity": bool, "boldTime": bool, "boldZone": bool}. Missing or empty entries fall back to "formatting-defaults", and ultimately to the current appearance. Each entry is a WHOLE blob, not a per-field diff against "formatting-defaults": setting only one field for a zone (e.g. via prefs.js) locks in the *current* "formatting-defaults" values for that zone's other fields at the moment of that edit, and the zone's override stops tracking future "formatting-defaults" changes for those other fields from then on.

key.name: formatting-defaults
key.description: A single JSON-encoded object of the same shape as the values in "formatting" ({"size": <int pt or 0=inherit>, "color": "#rrggbb" or "", "boldCity": bool, "boldTime": bool, "boldZone": bool}), used as the fallback for any zone without a per-entry override in "formatting". An empty string means no defaults are set and the current appearance is preserved.
